title: Twice Epi-Differentiability of Spectral Functions and its applications
summary: Second-order variational properties have been shown to play important theoretical and numerical roles for different classes of optimization problems. Among such properties, twice epi-differentiability has a special place because of its ubiquitous presence in various classes of extended-real-valued functions that are important for optimization problems. We provide a useful characterization of this property for spectral functions by demonstrating that it can be characterized via the same property of the symmetric part of the spectral representation of an eigenvalue function.
